recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, monochromatic head-and-shoulders portrait of a man wearing a baseball cap and jacket, set against a dark, textured background. The composition features large, thin geometric typography anchored at the bottom, with smaller secondary text below it.
coreVisualRelationships: The subject's direct gaze creates an immediate connection with the viewer.
The light-colored text contrasts sharply against the dark clothing and background.
The horizontal bar of the cap's brim mirrors the horizontal alignment of the primary text.
The vignette effect focuses light on the face while fading the shoulders into the darkness.
coreInvariants: Strict black and white color palette.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered, medium-close-up portrait occupying the upper two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the large-scale primary title at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's eyes, moves down the bridge of the nose to the beard, and settles on the large typographic block at the base.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive dark negative space in the upper corners and background to emphasize the subject.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pure white for typography and highlights.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Mid-tone grays for skin textures and clothing details.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation; high value contrast between the text/face and the background.

characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'M' has vertical outer legs with a deep central valley.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family used in different scales and colors (white vs gray) to establish hierarchy.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary geometric structure and clean lines.
Open-source alternative with similar wide geometric properties.
Classic geometric choice, though may require manual tracking adjustments.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a monochromatic, high-contrast portrait of a man with a beard wearing a baseball cap and a leather jacket. Use low-key lighting with a dark, grainy background and a subtle vignette that fades the bottom of the subject into black.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, centered title in the lower third using a white, hairline-weight geometric sans-serif font with wide tracking. Below that, add a secondary line of text in a smaller, medium-gray font with even wider tracking.

verificationChecks: Is the image strictly black and white?
Is the primary text hairline weight?
Is there a visible grain or film texture?

mustRedesign: Any specific logos on the cap must be replaced with generic textures or different designs.
Specific wording must be changed to user-defined titles.

avoid: Crushed blacks that lose all detail in the jacket

postGenerationChecks: Check for typographic legibility against the background.
Ensure the grain texture is uniform across the image.
Verify the 'hairline' weight is consistent across all characters.
Confirm the absence of any color artifacts.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a low-key monochromatic portrait with bottom-aligned, wide-tracked geometric hairline typography for a modern, minimalist editorial look.
